name: What is the typical design-build process for a new porch or covered patio?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical design-build process for a new porch or covered patio?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group approaches porch and covered patio construction through our integrated design-build process. This begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, needs, and how you plan to use the space for entertaining or relaxation. We then move into detailed design planning, often utilizing CAD-supported layouts, to ensure the new structure complements your home's architecture and enhances functionality. Once the design is finalized and approved, we manage all necessary permit coordination and construction, guiding the project from foundation to final finishes. This single point of coordination ensures a cohesive outcome and streamlined homeowner experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design-build process for porches involves consultation, CAD-supported design, permit coordination, and comprehensive construction management, ensuring a unified vision from concept to completion.
